import Mathlib

theorem p05 : ¬ ∃ q : ℚ, q * q = 2 := by
  rintro ⟨q, hq⟩
  apply irrational_sqrt_two
  refine ⟨|q|, ?_⟩
  have h2 : ((|q| : ℚ) : ℝ) ^ 2 = 2 := by
    rw [Rat.cast_abs, sq_abs, sq, ← Rat.cast_mul, hq]
    norm_num
  rw [← h2, Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
